# Bundled Component Licence Evidence

This directory contains upstream licence texts and component-specific rights
or attribution notices for material redistributed in the Fabulor Windows
package. The authoritative component mapping is `../components.json`;
generated release notices and the CycloneDX SBOM must be produced from that
manifest.

Do not add a component to the Windows payload without adding its licence
identity and evidence to the manifest. Do not edit imported upstream licence
texts except to preserve their original line endings or encoding.
